original_card.question: Can a legal decoder or coframe change improve the full signed moment, including changed helper targets?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

original_card.first_experiment: Price one complete changed itinerary with both paid and productive histograms. Check #5693/#5698 for overlap and their exact hypotheses before another coframe search. Use the signed invoice preflight where its boundary contract agrees; an inconclusive concave comparison is not a power crossing. Stop if an optimistic complete budget fails at the chosen target or native delivery remains unspecified.

actual_scope: Sharp paid-moment obstruction for independent nontrivial one-transvection charts on all 62 induced four-cycles in the fixed retained 640-input centre graph, with helper targets held fixed.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a legal decoder or coframe change can improve the full signed moment. This prices one complete changed producer on the historical retained-centre graph: independent one-transvection charts on every induced four-cycle, with incident charges, native maps, boundaries and all 408 productive helper targets held fixed. PR6336 closed the four-contact trees on this card and left the 62 cycles open. PR5693 and PR5698 are different coframe contracts and are not the alphabet used here. The optimistic paid bill is strictly positive, so the contract does not improve kappa. This is not a decoder of the selected PR6030 word.
bottleneck_link: An optimistic complete signed bill for this changed four-cycle producer is strictly higher on the paid side while productive targets stay fixed, so the interface is excluded before native, delivery or restoration costs are added.
stop_rule: Stop once every induced four-cycle on this fixed graph is priced. Five-contact blocks, changed routes, helper-target changes, native delivery, supplier admission and kappa optimization are outside this contribution.
evidence: PROOF.md and verify.py: 62 cycles, 558 exact prefix minimizations matched to literal histograms, componentwise minima (2,2,2,2,2,2,2,0,0), and one witness attaining 2(1+7^theta-8^theta) for every theta in (0,1).
